svg.aria-label: Languages: Python, HTML / CSS, JavaScript, Java, TypeScript, Other. Web: React, Vite, TypeScript, Flask, FastAPI, Go, Node.js, HTML, CSS. Databases: PostgreSQL, SQLite, SQL, migrations. Systems: C++17, C, GCC, CMake, Raylib. Machine learning: PyTorch, Keras, scikit-learn, NumPy, pandas, Matplotlib, Jupyter, RapidMiner. DevOps: Docker, Docker Compose, WSL2 (Ubuntu), Caddy, GitHub Actions. Testing: pytest, JUnit, go test. Security: Password hashing, role-based access, HttpOnly session cookies, OAuth sign-in. Tools: Git, GitHub, VS Code, Eclipse. Docs & design: LaTeX, TikZ, draw.io, UML.
